title: Two towns during a solar eclipse
body: During a solar eclipse, students in Town P saw the Moon slowly cover the whole Sun. For a few minutes it became dark in the middle of the day and some bright stars became visible. Soon a bright 'diamond ring' appeared as the Moon began to move away, and daylight returned. On the same day, students in Town Q, about 300 km away, joined a viewing event organised by a planetarium. Using the image of the Sun projected on a screen by a small mirror, they saw the Moon cover only a part of the Sun's disc, and it never became dark there. Both towns had clear skies throughout.
